scheme_name: Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme for Backward Classes- Haryana
description:
The Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme for Backward Classes in Haryana was launched on 1st April 2021. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals belonging to backward classes in Haryana. 

The primary objective of the Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is to promote entrepreneurship among backward classes. 

The scheme focuses on enhancing the economic conditions of these communities through self-employment opportunities. 

The Haryana government has set a target to provide financial support to at least 5,000 beneficiaries under this scheme in the first year. 

The financial assistance offered under the Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is up to INR 10 lakh per beneficiary. 

The loan amount is provided at a subsidized interest rate of 6 percent per annum. 

The government aims to create at least 10,000 new jobs through the implementation of this scheme. 

The assistance under this scheme can be utilized for various purposes including setting up new businesses and expanding existing enterprises. 

Eligible activities include manufacturing, service sector projects, and trade-related businesses. 

The scheme also aims to provide skill development training to beneficiaries to enhance their capabilities. 

The eligibility criteria for applicants include being a resident of Haryana. 

Applicants must belong to a backward class as defined by the Haryana government. 

The age limit for applicants is between 18 years and 55 years. 

The income criteria state that the annual income of the applicant should not exceed INR 3 lakh. 

Educational qualifications are not strictly defined but having basic literacy is preferred. 

The application process begins with the submission of a detailed project report. 

Applicants must provide a clear business plan outlining the proposed business activities. 

The required documents include proof of identity such as Aadhaar card or voter ID. 

Applicants must also submit proof of residence and caste certificate. 

A bank account statement may be required to verify the financial status of the applicant. 

Once the application is submitted it will be reviewed by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. 

The processing time for loan applications is approximately 30 days. 

Disbursement of the loan amount is made in installments based on the progress of the business. 

The first installment is released after the approval of the project report. 

Subsequent installments are released based on the achievement of predefined milestones. 

The scheme also provides for a moratorium period of 6 months before the repayment begins. 

Loan repayment is expected to be completed within a period of 5 years. 

The Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam is the implementing authority for this scheme. 

The Nigam operates under the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes. 

The contact details for the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam are available on their official website. 

The Nigam provides support and guidance to applicants throughout the application process. 

The scheme is part of the Haryana government's broader initiative to uplift marginalized communities. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

The Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is expected to contribute significantly to the state's economy. 

By promoting entrepreneurship it aims to reduce unemployment rates among backward classes. 

The scheme is also aligned with the government's vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat or self-reliant India. 

The initiative encourages innovation and self-sufficiency among the youth of Haryana. 

Regular workshops and training sessions are organized to equip beneficiaries with necessary skills. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of digital literacy in today's business environment. 

Beneficiaries are encouraged to adopt modern technology in their business practices. 

The Haryana government monitors the progress of the scheme through regular evaluations. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the implementation process. 

The scheme also aims to create a supportive ecosystem for small businesses. 

Collaboration with financial institutions is encouraged to facilitate easier access to credit. 

The Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is a significant step towards economic empowerment. 

It seeks to bridge the gap between different socio-economic classes in Haryana. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders. 

Beneficiaries report increased confidence in starting their own businesses. 

The government plans to expand the scheme based on its success in the initial years. 

The Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is a vital tool for socio-economic development. 

It aims to create a sustainable livelihood for backward classes in Haryana. 

The scheme is expected to foster a culture of entrepreneurship among the youth. 

The Haryana government remains committed to supporting marginalized communities through various initiatives. 

The Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is one of many welfare schemes aimed at uplifting the economically weaker sections. 

The scheme's success will be measured by the number of businesses established and jobs created. 

Overall the Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme for Backward Classes in Haryana represents a comprehensive approach to economic empowerment. 

It combines financial assistance with skill development and support services. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the Haryana government's commitment to inclusive growth. 

The Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is a model for similar initiatives across India. 

It highlights the importance of targeted support for marginalized communities. 

The scheme is a step towards achieving equitable economic development in the state. 

The Haryana government encourages all eligible individuals to take advantage of this opportunity. 

The Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme is a beacon of hope for many aspiring entrepreneurs.
